summary: BuildMitra Admin Panel (iteration 2) tested end-to-end. Backend: 22/22 pytest cases passing for /api/admin/* — stats, users list+filter+search, verify/suspend/unsuspend (suspended user correctly gets 403 on login), jobs list + close, complaints list + resolve + reject, 404 on unknown ids, and non-admin (worker/client) authorization guards. Frontend: admin demo button (testID demo-admin) autofills 9000000000/admin1234, login redirects to /admin/dashboard. All 5 admin tabs render correctly on 390x844 mobile viewport: Dashboard (KPI grid + Open Complaints + Wallet Payouts cards), Users (role chips, search, Verify/Suspend buttons per row), Jobs (9 cards including 1 CLOSED — close-job button on open ones), Complaints (2 seeded OPEN items with Resolve/Reject buttons), Profile (role badge, admin powers list, Logout). Previous worker/client/contractor flows untouched.

react_native_issues.issue: testID set directly on H1/H2/Body (Text-based) components does not always forward to data-testid on RN Web. Affected: admin-greeting (dashboard.tsx:44), admin-users-title (users.tsx:49), admin-jobs-title (jobs.tsx:35), admin-complaints-title (complaints.tsx:47), admin-name (profile.tsx:24), kpi-complaints / kpi-payouts (Body inside Card). UI renders correctly and content is visible; this only impacts e2e selectors. testIDs on View/Pressable/SecondaryButton wrappers (KPI cards, action buttons, demo-admin, admin-logout, admin-role-*, admin-user-*, admin-job-*, complaint-*, verify-*, suspend-*, unsuspend-*, close-job-*, resolve-*, reject-*) all work correctly.

action_items: Optional: wrap title H1/H2 inside <View testID=...> or use a wrapping component so testIDs reliably forward to data-testid on RN Web. Same for KPI value Body where testID is needed.

Cleanup TEST_ data created by pytest (e.g., one closed TEST_close_* job, 2 resolved/rejected TEST_ complaints, a few TEST_AdminTarget_* worker accounts). They will not affect demo behaviour but appear in admin lists.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin role guard: /api/admin/* uses admin_user dependency that returns 403 if role != 'admin' — verified via worker and client tokens (5 tests).
Suspended-user login block correctly returns 403 with message 'Account suspended. Contact support.' — verified end-to-end (register → suspend → login=403 → unsuspend → login=200).

Admin seed is idempotent only via the outer 'count clients > 0' guard. If an admin is deleted while clients exist, seed() will not re-create the admin. Low-priority improvement: check admin existence separately.
complaints/{cid}/resolve|reject accept 'note' as query param (Optional[str]). Frontend currently sends no note — works, but consider switching to JSON body for parity with other endpoints.

Frontend admin _layout correctly redirects non-admin users to /(tabs)/home and unauthenticated users to /role-select — guards verified by reading code; cannot directly simulate cross-role browser session in single-tab Playwright run.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 admin tabs render, demo-admin button works, navigation works, action buttons present with testIDs)

seed_data_creation: pytest run created: 1 TEST_close_* job (closed), ~2 TEST_ complaints (resolved/rejected via admin), and a few TEST_AdminTarget_* worker accounts. Demo data (9000000000/01/02/03) and 2 seeded open complaints + 8 seeded jobs untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin tests at /app/backend/tests/test_admin.py (22 tests, all passing). Previous worker/client tests at /app/backend/tests/test_buildmitra.py (13 tests, passing). Admin login: 9000000000/admin1234 → /admin/dashboard. Frontend testIDs available: demo-admin, login-submit, kpi-workers/contractors/clients/pending/active-jobs/completed-jobs/applications/attendance, admin-role-{all|worker|contractor|client}, admin-users-search, admin-user-{id}, verify-{id}, suspend-{id}, unsuspend-{id}, admin-job-{id}, close-job-{id}, complaint-filter-{open|resolved|rejected|all}, complaint-{id}, resolve-{id}, reject-{id}, admin-logout. testIDs on H1/H2/Body Text wrappers may not forward to data-testid on RN Web — prefer querying by visible text or by wrapper View.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found in this iteration. All 22 backend tests passed first run; all admin UI flows render correctly.
